chapters.title: Max of every window
chapters.code:
def max_sliding_window(nums, k):
    return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)]

frames.caption: Max of every window — O(n · k) time, O(1) beyond output extra space. Input: max_sliding_window(nums=[9, 1, 2, 3, 1, 4, 0], k=3). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — i = 0
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — i = 1
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — i = 2
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — i = 3
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — i = 4
return [max(nums[i:i + k]) for i in range(len(nums) - k + 1)] — returns [9, 3, 3, 4, 4]. Result: [9, 3, 3, 4, 4]
